mainEntity.name: When should a medical practice consider investing in AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A medical practice should consider investing in AI SEO when they notice a decline in new patient inquiries, struggle to rank for relevant keywords, or feel overwhelmed by the complexities of traditional SEO. It's particularly beneficial for practices looking to expand their patient base, compete effectively in highly saturated markets like New York City or Los Angeles, or enhance their online visibility with data-driven precision. If your current marketing efforts aren't yielding desired results, AI SEO offers a sophisticated approach to identify and capitalize on digital opportunities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Medical practices should consider AI SEO when experiencing low patient inquiries, poor search rankings, or when seeking a data-driven approach to grow and compete effectively.
